notes:
Summary: Tilted Anchor is a mid-market product analytics SaaS building an in-app assistant (chat) + semantic search layer. Started with Redwood Hosted API to validate quality and integration. Post-trial they want a Dedicated plan for steady traffic and predictable unit costs. POC takeaways and ask:
- Workload mix: primary chat (user-facing assistant) ~65% of calls, embeddings for search ~25%, reranking/other endpoints ~10%.
- Observed traffic during 2-week hosted trial: baseline sustained QPS ~12, typical working-hour spikes to ~75-95 QPS during customer release windows.
- Token mix observed (hosted trial telemetry): ~60% short responses (<64 tokens), ~30% medium responses (64-512 tokens), ~10% long responses (>512 tokens). Avg tokens per chat response ~130 tokens. Embeddings input avg ~480 tokens (chunked docs).
- Daily token volume (trial extrapolated): ~9M tokens/day typical, peak day ~14M tokens. Peak hour token rate ~1.2M tokens/hr.
- Concurrency / capacity: engineering estimates need to handle 120 concurrent chat streams at 95th percentile to support multi-region users and on-demand bursts.
- Desired latency SLO: p50 <200ms, p95 <600ms for hosted-like prompt lengths. Customer emphasized p95 requirement for SLAs.
- Security / compliance: require SSO/SAML + SOC2; must support KMS integration and audit logging. Data residency: EU customer subset requires EU-only storage.
- Pricing sensitivity: finance NICHE: aiming for committed ARR in $60k-120k band; target effective per-token cost < $0.002 for chat mix to be economical.
- Dedicated sizing ask: Customer requested Redwood recommendation for node counts. Rough internal SA guidance from Derek: for current mix and 95th percentile targets -> starting Dedicated cluster equivalent to ~3-4 V100/A10-class GPUs (or 2x A100 / 80GB-equivalent) with autoscale headroom 25% for burst. Derek to provide model-variant throughput matrix before 2026-03-15 call.
- Risks & blockers: legal needs data residency clause; finance needs committed discount tiers to approve; engineering wants a smoke test in VPC prior to cutover.
- Quotes from customer: "We liked the hosted speed and debug telemetry — but we need price predictability and direct network control for Q3 launch."
- Next steps: 1) Capacity planning call 2026-03-15 to finalize node # and burst policy; 2) SE to deliver throughput matrix (model x sequence-length x QPS) and cost estimates; 3) legal to start residency addendum; 4) send Dedicated PO template and draft SLA.
- Reference artifacts: hosted trial logs (s3://tilted-anchor/trial-logs-0226), demo recording ff-2026-02-18-tilted-01, pricing deck in Drive.
